rows.grounds: compound describing a rogue whose pride arises from anger

items.question: What birth-time nakshatra condition produces a rogue whose pride is born of anger?
premises: Purva Phalguni at birth time indicates rogue nature
anger-born pride characterizes the resulting person
the condition is stated as a birth-time rule
items.inference: A birth under Purva Phalguni yields a rogue whose pride arises from anger.
uncertainties: exact syntactic relation between the nakshatra and the rogue-pride compound is compressed
the verse may be an astrological rule rather than a doctrinal claim
items.plain_english: If at birth time the moon is in Purva Phalguni, the person becomes a rogue whose pride is born of anger.
